steps.instruction:

對照「點雲坐標界面」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。無足夠可見抓取面時標為不可決，不以補值點直接生成抓取姿態。
本階段必須重驗：由視差推深度並評估遠距誤差放大，把可見點與可抓取姿態分開。
steps.instructionEn:
Depth jumps on shiny surfaces may be mismatches; use left-right consistency and texture rather than smoothing them away.
Against the nominal Point-cloud frame interfaces result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Mark insufficiently visible grasp surfaces as undecidable; do not derive grasps directly from imputed points.
Reverify this criterion: Infer depth from disparity and assess distant-error amplification, distinguishing visible points from graspable poses.

steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Depth jumps on shiny surfaces may be mismatches; use left-right consistency and texture rather than smoothing them away.

steps.instruction:

steps.instructionEn:
Deliver disparity-depth table, occlusion mask, uncertainty and candidate grasp surfaces.
